Sauté it for 1-2 minutes over medium heat to allow the aromatic compounds to infuse into the vegetables. Be careful not to overcook it, as this can diminish the flavor. Use high heat to ensure the garlic cooks quickly and thoroughly. This method enhances the garlic's potency by allowing its strong scent and taste to meld with the vegetables.
